title: Language isolate - Wikipedia
text: A language isolate, sometimes called an isolated language, is a language that has no demonstrable genealogical relationship with any other language. [1][2] That is, an isolate is a language family that only contains one member.

title: Elseng Language (MRF) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map ... - Ethnologue
text: Elseng is an endangered indigenous language of Indonesia. It is an isolate that is not known to be related to any other language. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people. It is not known to be taught in schools.
